C. I. D.
F. O. REG
No 146
Date 7/3/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

March 7th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang has sent a code telegram to the Central Government saying that they do not need to concern themselves about Shanghai, as the situation is well in hand. The same telegram mentions that there are no less than thirty rebel organisations in Hangchow and Soochow and urges the Government to pay strict attention to these places.
It is reported in rebel circles that the Military Governors of the different provinces with the exception of General Chang Hsun, have agreed to join the Republicans.
It is said that General Han, whose arrival from Peking was reported yesterday, has given orders to various contractors for 50,000 pairs of boots and 50,000 suits of uniform.
The Arsenal troops are at present being hastily put through a musketry course.
The Chapei Police search all persons who are in the streets of that district after 9 p.m.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：Entered on M.S. March 7.）

（批：Referred to Commandant, S.V.C., Special Section）

刑事调查处
外交部登记处
第 146 号
日期：1916年3月7日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处
（侦探科）

1916年3月7日

先生：

据报，杨将军已向中央政府发送密电，称无需担忧上海局势，因一切均在掌控之中。该电文还提及杭州和苏州至少有三十个反叛组织，并敦促政府密切关注这些地方。

据反叛圈子消息，除张勋将军外，各省督军已同意加入共和派。

据悉，昨日报道已从北京抵达的韩将军，已向各承包商下达订单，订购五万双靴子和五万套制服。

兵工厂部队目前正匆忙进行步枪射击训练。

闸北警察对晚上九点后在该区街道上的人员进行搜查。

您忠实的仆人，

首席探长

警务处总监

（批注：3月7日录入 M.S.。）

（批注：转交上海义勇队指挥官，特别组）
